GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Went Forward and shared lead Two Wide 700m, took over soon after Straightening Up and despite big weight he held margin for Clear on pace win # tough win

Jumped well. Pushed fwd & worked to share lead on inside early . Stayed =lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken =lead on inside on home. Pressured Four Wide @ cutaway & fought on until shaded in last few bounds. # On-pace/tried hard.

Away fairly. Pushed fwd & raced 3rd Two Wide (4L from lead). Held Ground midrace until pushed to quicken from 600m & improved to 1 length from lead @ 450m. Held together =lead Two Wide on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & headed @ 200m. Weakened once headed. # didn't finish off

Began OK. Rolled fwd & raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (1.5L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace until strode to =lead Four Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Four Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & fought on unrtil faded in last 50m. # Wide/tried hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping away. Raced wide without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair keen early Restrained back Settled Down Worse than midfield 6l same to turn stays inner never ran on # always back
